slides.headline: SOMEONE STOLE $4B OVER 9 YEARS. THESE 6 PROMPTS PROTECT YOUR MONEY BEFORE YOU PAY ANYONE
slides.image_prompt: Dario Amodei waist-up in dark detective trenchcoat with magnifying glass over contract, fierce triumph expression, shadowy background, 35mm, dramatic clean light, film grain. Blood-red accent, charcoal depths.

slides.headline: 1) FIND EVERY TRAP HIDING IN YOUR CONTRACT
slides.body: Lawyers charge $400 an hour to read contracts. This finds the same traps in 30 seconds. "Here is my contract: [PASTE]. Find every clause that protects them and hurts me."

slides.headline: 2) CHECK ANYONE'S REAL HISTORY BEFORE YOU PAY
slides.body:
Most business owners don't know what to search before paying someone. This does it for you.
"I'm paying [NAME] $[AMOUNT]. List what to Google, what documents to demand, and 2 walk-away red flags."

slides.headline: 3) SCAN ANY FINANCIAL STATEMENT FOR HIDDEN LIES
slides.body:
Most embezzlement hides in the same 3 places on a financial statement. This prompt knows where to look.
"Here is my financial statement: [PASTE]. Find anomalies, missing line items, and anything I should question."

slides.headline: 9 YEARS. $4 BILLION. STILL GONE.
slides.body: Ruja Ignatova has been on the FBI's most wanted list since 2017. She's accused of running the biggest fake investment in history.

slides.headline: 4) SPOT FAKE REVIEWS BEFORE YOU TRUST ANYONE
slides.body:
Five-star scammers steal millions. The pattern is always the same.
"Here are reviews for [BUSINESS]: [PASTE]. Which look fake, what are they hiding, and would you trust them with $10,000?"

slides.headline: 5) WRITE FRAUD-PROOF PAYMENT TERMS
slides.body:
Most contracts assume good faith. This one doesn't.
"I'm hiring [NAME] for [SERVICE]. Write a milestone payment clause. Money releases only when each phase is done and includes a refund if they vanish."

slides.headline: 6) ASK REFERENCES QUESTIONS THEY CAN'T DODGE
slides.body:
Fraudsters pick their own references. This prompt turns the table.
"Give me 7 questions to ask [NAME's] references that reveal if they're lying about experience, reliability, or where the money went."

caption:
Swipe for all 6. The FBI spent 9 years searching for a woman charged with stealing $4 billion. AI catches the same red flags before you pay anyone. 🔍

1) Contract trap-finder, 2) due-diligence checklist before any payment, 3) financial statement anomaly scan, 4) fake review detector, 5) fraud-proof milestone payment clause, 6) reference questions that catch lies. Every prompt is short enough to retype from a screenshot.

Fraud costs the average small business over $100,000 per incident, and most victims say they had no idea until it was too late. AI does in 30 seconds what a lawyer charges $400 an hour to catch. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: FBI, Anthropic, Association of Certified Fraud Examiners
